'''Michel Safady''' (Michel Salim Safady) of São Paulo, Brazil, represented the Outer Rim at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="safady">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/safady.html Michel Safady], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428082315/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/safady.html Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 18th at [[1997 Decipher World Championship First Anthology Sealed]].<ref name="dec-sealed">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sealedsummary.html Report 10], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19980223172645/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sealedsummary.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"Age, 29."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/safady.html Michel Safady], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428082315/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/safady.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"Responsible Time: I have 2 university degrees, in Marketing and Business Administration."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I 'm the General Manager of Trans Ocean, a freight company."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My beautiful wife Silvana and I have been married for two years."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Funny Time: I love Star Wars CCG, Magic: The Gathering and role-playing Star Wars."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I like video games, too."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I'm a musician, play the guitar, and have a heavy metal band."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I was a professional basketball player for seven years."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I love Pink and Brain Comics."<ref name="dec97bio" />
